newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end up, spots end.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end up, spots end.

text.p: Contracts on the treasury bill repurchase market in Shanghai closed mostly up on Monday because of support for a surging domestic A share market, traders said.
The annual rate for the most active seven-day contract rose sharply to 15.55 percent from 10.77 percent last Friday.
Turnover expanded to 11.65 million lots from 5.77 million. One lot is 1,000 yuan face value of treasury bills.

Shanghai's A share index surged 5.79 percent today and its Shenzhen counterpart 2.29 percent. The listing of Nanjing Panda Electronics Co in Shanghai today and a new A share issue on Tuesday also sucked funds out of the repo market, traders said.
